correctness.rationale: PASS: Multiplication gives gh=hg iff A_gB_h-A_hB_g=0, exactly XY=0 for independent uniform 2m-square matrices. The count of rank-r X is q^{r(4m-r)} Phi_{2m}^2/(Phi_r Phi_{2m-r}^2); each has q^{2m(2m-r)} compatible Y. The normalized formula has exponent -3m^2-t^2 and the group order is q^{8m^2}; hence k(G)=q^{8m^2} cp. The uniform tail product Q_j=1-q^{-j}/(q-1)+O_q(q^{-2j}) yields the two-term summed expansion with domination q^{-t^2+2|t|}; it also holds after multiplying by |t|, giving total variation and mean. Under t->1-t the first odd-weight moment is Xi(q)/2, proving negative bias; nonzero mean is not claimed at finite m. Independently enumerated all q=2,m=1 matrix pairs: rank-stratum counts (16,36,6), total 58, matching actual class number. Independently evaluated q=2,m=3,5,8,12 Euler-product series at 70-decimal precision; q^{2m}-scaled two-term residual remains bounded and signed mean agrees with coefficient. The infinite result rests on the analytic uniform error, not finite data.
